# zerotier_v2_member (Resource)

A device's membership of a Central V2 network. The device does not need to have joined yet; creating the member pre-approves it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "zerotier_identity" "server" {}

resource "zerotier_v2_member" "server" {
  network_id = zerotier_v2_network.lab.id
  device_id  = zerotier_identity.server.id
  name       = "server"
  status     = "authorized"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (String) ZeroTier address of the device (10 lowercase hex characters).
- `network_id` (String) ID of the network.

### Optional

- `active_bridge` (Boolean) Allow the member to bridge other traffic onto the network.
- `description` (String) Description of the member.
- `ipv4_assignments` (List of String) IPv4 addresses assigned to the member. Left unset, Central auto-assigns from the network's pools. Set `no_auto_assign_ips` when assigning an empty list.
- `ipv6_assignments` (List of String) IPv6 addresses assigned to the member. Left unset, Central auto-assigns from the network's pools.
- `name` (String) Name of the member.
- `no_auto_assign_ips` (Boolean) Exempt the member from automatic IP assignment.
- `status` (String) One of `authorized`, `not_authorized` or `rejected`. Defaults to `authorized`.

### Read-Only

- `creation_time` (String) When the member was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) `<network_id>/<device_id>`.
- `identity` (String) Public identity of the device, once it has joined.
- `ip_assignment_6plane` (String) 6PLANE address, when the network assigns them.
- `ip_assignment_rfc4193` (String) RFC 4193 address, when the network assigns them.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# <network_id>/<device_id>
terraform import zerotier_v2_member.server 8056c2e21c1930be/abcdef0123
```
